title: Studio action designer: the refusals and texts rows reach only the Related drawer editor; the full-page editor and Studio design surface show them as raw JSON
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgX6mQpVU8yUysiRAFC

Filing gate: **(b) out-of-scope finding** of PR #35636 (Fixes #35096, #34823), nit N1 of its contract review (record 7022528162), adopted by the seat (7022564983) with this card as its disposition. **Pre-existing**: no `ui/` path is in PR #35636, so every host below behaves as it did before it. Dedupe: searched open issues for `ActionDefaultInspector` and `action designer refusals texts raw JSON`; none.

Suggested-grade: p2 (the follow-up that makes the #35096 / #34823 rows reach the editor an author normally uses) · suggested domain `domain:ui` · area:build · for triage first touch.

## What happens
- PR #35636 adds `refusals` and `texts` key-only-record rows to the served `action` form (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts`), gated `data.type == 'script'` like `body`.
- The served form is drawn as a layout only where a host hands it to `SchemaForm`. For `action` that is one host: `ResourceEditPage` in its `embedded` mount (the Related drawer).
- The full-page editor takes its designer branch, because `action` registers both a preview and a default inspector; the Studio design surface mounts the same `ActionDefaultInspector`. That inspector's "More fields" form gets the served schema and no `form`, and its curated keys do not include `refusals` or `texts`, so `resolveFieldFace` gives each the raw JSON editor, without the key-only face or the help text. The create page passes no form either.
- The hook rows reach the hook's full-page editor because `hook` registers no preview, so hooks are not affected.
- Read on the tree at PR #35636 head `5cddfca1`, not run.

## Ask
- The action designer (`ActionDefaultInspector`, full-page editor and Studio design surface, and the create page) draws `refusals` and `texts` with the served rows' key-only-record face and help text, with a pin per host.
- Carry with it: the console's zh-CN overlay `metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` has no leaves for the action `refusals` / `texts` rows, nor for hook `texts`; add them.
- ⛔ No schema or served-form change: the rows on `actionForm` are the contract; this card only makes the designer hosts read them.

## Reader
The seat that takes `domain:ui` Studio cards.
